draftReply: Honestly, realistic bouldering physics (especially full limb articulation for flagging and dynamic movement/dynos) are super rare in browser format—most climbing games end up being quick ragdoll QWOP-style mechanics. We build instant browser-based physics and sports games over at Kreeda (kreeda.games), but we haven't tackled rock climbing yet. Outside of browser games, you might want to look into indie physics projects like 'Cruux' or 'Peak Angle' on PC for more technical movement simulation.
